test_case.test_name: AMD OOB UMC replay-correctable ODECC with quiet-window proof
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved replay-correctable ODECC stimulus produces the exact corrected HBMEccErr CPER and does not continue or escalate afterward.
required_package: Authenticated Systems/UBB endpoint and CPER schema
Replay counter/quiet-window oracle and GPU/BMC/host recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records full CPER/counter/health baseline, validates target/replay semantics, executes `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 4 -a 0x800` once, attributes/hash-verifies/decodes the new CPER, validates HBMEccErr corrected fields, observes the approved quiet window for no continuing replay/escalation, then verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: A unique CPER identifies the intended OAM/UMC with ext0 HBMEccErr corrected severity; replay activity ceases within the approved window, no fatal/deferred escalation appears, and platform health remains good.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact replay target/tool identity, one command, unique corrected CPER, quiet-window/counter compliance and recovery. Continuing records, wrong severity/address, ambiguous artifact or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Approved replay-correctable injection on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Define quiet-window and stop/recovery behavior before execution.
Preserve CPER/counter baseline with collision-safe attribution.
One command only; no automatic retry/reset.
expected_evidence: Single command and unique entry diff/hashes
Replay quiet-window and final GPU/BMC/host health
test_case.recovery: On continuing replay, escalation, wrong target or connectivity loss, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery only; never reissue the command automatically and verify every accelerator afterward.
